module.purpose: Provides signed thumbnail-render job tokens and R2-backed token-record lifecycle operations for the sync worker's published-board, shared-file, OG, and MCP rendering flows.
module.summary: This module defines the serialized render-job contract, signs jobs with an HMAC secret, verifies signatures and expiry, and validates supported job fields. It also namespaces token records by board and rendering surface, records only private render jobs, supports legacy key lookup during rolling deployment, deletes per-capture records best effort, and removes all records during board cleanup.
module.businessContext: Supports secure thumbnail and screenshot generation for tldraw boards. Failure can block OG images, MCP captures, private-board rendering, or cleanup while token validation prevents unauthorized snapshot access.

sectionMap.intent: Decode, authenticate, validate, and expire an incoming render token.
sectionMap.predicate:
if (
		!job ||
		job.v !== 1 ||
		(job.kind !== 'published' && job.kind !== 'shared_file') ||
		typeof job.slug !== 'string' ||
		(job.access !== undefined && job.access !== 'public' && job.access !== 'render') ||
		(job.surface !== undefined && job.surface !== 'og' && job.surface !== 'mcp') ||
		(job.camera !== undefined && job.camera !== 'content') ||
		(job.pageId !== undefined && typeof job.pageId !== 'string') ||
		(job.mode !== undefined && job.mode !== 'screenshot' && job.mode !== 'measure') ||
		(job.shapeIds !== undefined &&
			(!Array.isArray(job.shapeIds) ||
				job.shapeIds.length === 0 ||
				!job.shapeIds.every((id) => typeof id === 'string'))) ||
		typeof job.exp !== 'number'
	)

preconditions: env.MCP_SCREENSHOT_TOKEN_SECRET is configured with a truthy value.

units.name: verifyThumbnailRenderToken

detail.name: verifyThumbnailRenderToken
detail.signature: export async function verifyThumbnailRenderToken(env: Environment, token: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<ThumbnailRenderJob | null>
postconditions: Returns a validated ThumbnailRenderJob when the token has the required two-part format, a valid HMAC signature, decodable JSON payload, and supported payload fields.
Returns null when the screenshot token secret is absent or token validation fails.
invariants: The HMAC is verified over the exact payload segment encoded as UTF-8.
The token must contain exactly two non-empty dot-separated segments.
Accepted payload versions have v equal to 1.
The payload kind must be either published or shared_file.
The payload slug must be a string.
Optional access, surface, camera, pageId, mode, and shapeIds fields are restricted to their supported types and values.
edgeCases: When env.MCP_SCREENSHOT_TOKEN_SECRET is absent or falsy, returns null without verifying the token.
When token does not split into exactly two non-empty dot-separated segments, returns null.
When the signature segment is not valid base64url, returns null.
When HMAC verification returns false, returns null.
When the payload cannot be base64url-decoded, UTF-8-decoded, or parsed as JSON, returns null.
When the decoded payload has an unsupported version or kind, a non-string slug, an unsupported optional field value, or an invalid shapeIds value, returns null.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns null for missing configuration, malformed token structure, invalid signature encoding, failed signature verification, malformed payload JSON, or unsupported payload fields.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Input token format is <base64url-encoded JSON payload>.<base64url-encoded HMAC signature>. The HMAC is computed with algorithm HMAC over the UTF-8 payload segment using env.MCP_SCREENSHOT_TOKEN_SECRET. On success, returns the decoded ThumbnailRenderJob object; otherwise returns null.
detail.summary: Asynchronously verifies a thumbnail render token using the configured screenshot-token secret and returns its validated render job. Invalid, malformed, unsigned, or structurally unsupported tokens produce null.

specLiterals.role: Web Crypto algorithm identifier used for signature verification.
Required thumbnail render token payload version.
